suggestion.title: Highlight Your Curves
suggestion.body: Your perfectly balanced shape looks best when the waist is highlighted. Wrap dresses, belted coats, and fitted tops are your best friends.

suggestion.title: Athletic Proportions
suggestion.body: You have a balanced, athletic build. Tailored V-necks, fitted shirts, and structured blazers work exceptionally well to enhance your natural proportions without looking overly constricted.

characteristics: Shoulders are usually rounded, from delicate to broad in size
Bust is medium to full in size and proportionate to the curves in the lower body
Round silhouette in the upper body

recommended_items.advice: Choose fitted T-shirts made from soft fabrics to highlight your natural curves without adding unnecessary bulk.
Halter tops showcase balanced shoulders and emphasize the waist, complementing an hourglass figure.
Trapeze tops provide a flattering drape while maintaining the natural balance of an hourglass silhouette.
Circle tops add soft movement while preserving your naturally balanced proportions.
Peplum tops accentuate the waist and enhance your natural curves.
Wrap tops cinch at the waist, highlighting your narrow midsection and emphasizing your curves.
V-neck tops draw attention to the bust and elongate the neck while maintaining balanced proportions.
Scoop neck tops flatter the bust and neckline while complementing an hourglass body shape.
Fitted button-down shirts define the waist and enhance your natural shape without adding bulk.

avoid_items.advice: Avoid boxy tops, as they can hide your curves and make your body appear less defined.
Avoid oversized tops because they can obscure your waist and create a shapeless silhouette.
Avoid high-neck tops, as they can make the bust appear larger and disrupt your balanced proportions.
Avoid loose, unstructured tops since they hide the waist and reduce the definition of your natural curves.

general_advice: Choose tops that define the waist and follow your natural curves rather than hiding them.

recommended_items.advice: Slim-fit pants follow your natural curves without being too tight, maintaining the balanced proportions of an hourglass figure.
Straight-leg pants create a clean, streamlined silhouette while complementing your naturally balanced shape.
Bootcut pants gently flare below the knee, balancing your curves while creating a long, elegant silhouette.
Wide-leg pants drape beautifully from the hips, maintaining your balanced proportions while adding graceful movement.
Pants with top-entry pockets create a smooth look around the hips without adding unnecessary bulk, flattering an hourglass figure.

avoid_items.advice: Avoid baggy pants, as they can hide your natural curves and make your silhouette appear less defined.

general_advice: Choose pants that follow your natural curves and define your waist without adding excess volume.
